Title: Germany West Central Availability Zones now generally available

Body.Content:
Availability Zones in Germany West Central are made up of 3 unique physically separated locations or “zones” within a single region to bring higher availability and asynchronous replication across Azure regions for disaster recovery protection.

With three zones in Germany, customers can enable even greater resilience, scalability and performance. Azure Availability Zones support organizations as they continue to innovate, support their people, create valued customer experiences and explore new avenues of growth.
